hints.title: Verifying Target Node Existence
hints.text: Unlike standard ancestor problems, nodes p and q might not both be present in the binary tree.

hints.title: Complete Tree Traversal
hints.text: Do not terminate early when finding p or q; continue searching both subtrees to confirm both targets exist.

hints.title: Tracking Occurrence Counter
hints.text: Maintain a counter or boolean flags for p and q. Return candidate ancestor only if both targets were observed.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Visits every node once during postorder traversal and uses recursion stack space proportional to height.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Returning immediately upon finding one node returns that node as ancestor even when the second node is missing.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Full traversal incurs full linear scan but guarantees correctness when target existence is unverified.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Postorder recursion with explicit verification that both query nodes were visited.
